_about: M1: Narrative's player-style labels (docs/narrative/style-thresholds.md, signed off by Game Design), loaded by sim/core/mood.gd. Percentages are integers, compared by cross-multiplication (100 x part > pct x whole) on the rolling window. Times are seconds at the 1 Hz evaluation. The measure strings are closed keys the code implements, not formulas it parses. An attack is an exchange the fighter's director started, counted by its weight at the start. The mixer's leaveMaxStancePct and leaveHoldS make its leaveWhen text a number.

mixer.definition: no dominant stance and a spread of attack kinds
mixer.leaveWhen: any other label enters, or the largest stance share exceeds 50 percent for 5 s
